main.remarks: Represents a single ordered policy rule that can participate asynchronously in a composite access-policy engine.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate a single ordered policy stage asynchronously from an access-policy context snapshot.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous policy-stage evaluation.
method.returns: Stage decision for the supplied context. Composite engines stop on the first deny decision.
